question: Are all tools on MicroToolStack free to use?
answer: Yes, 100% free! Every tool on MicroToolStack is accessible without registration, subscriptions, or hidden charges.

question: Is my data stored or tracked on your servers?
answer: No. Most of our text, SEO, and developer utilities run client-side directly in your browser. Your text stays entirely private.

question: Do I need to create an account to use the tools?
answer: No sign-up is required. You can jump straight to any tool and start processing your data instantly.

question: How fast are the tools?
answer: Because client-side tools run in your own web browser using lightweight modern JS, processing speed is nearly instant.
